column1: # One project per row; cells are separated by tabs. The script clones `url` at `commit`, translates `package`
# and fails when fewer files are written or parse than the two minimums. Raise a minimum when a fix earns it.
# tier: pr runs in the Linux job of ci.yml once the tests before it have passed, nightly in corpus.yml.
# The minimums were measured on the CI runner (Python 3.14): py2v's frontend parses with the installed Python,
# so a project that uses newer syntax gives fewer files there (six of TheAlgorithms' files need Python 3.15).
